verdict.rationale: Bizfile offers public search of business records. Founders can view and print filed entity documents, including formations, amendments and statements of information, which implies whether a filing is on record. 'Verify Issuance of an Apostille' is a public check on one type of application. No documented filing, application or case status tracker for business submissions appears; the vote-by-mail ballot tracker is a different service. Missing for 10: a documented public status lookup for pending business filings or cases, coverage beyond apostilles, and hands-on corroboration that status is visible.
